summary: Adult paddleboarder died after being separated from their paddleboard during high winds and waves on Grass Valley Reservoir; four paddleboarders without life jackets were caught in rough conditions and the untethered boarder failed to surface. CPW officers and Garfield County Sheriff's deputies confirmed a missing person in the water; CPW launched two boats with sonar, then CPW's Marine Evidence Recovery Team took over the water search and recovered the body around 10 p.m. with a submersible drone; remains turned over to the Garfield County Coroner.
location: Grass Valley Reservoir, Harvey Gap State Park, near Silt
responding_agency: Colorado Parks and Wildlife (officers + Marine Evidence Recovery Team); Garfield County Sheriff's Office deputies; Garfield County Coroner
notes: Incident date Saturday 2024-05-18 (CPW news item published 2024-05-20, incident 'Saturday afternoon'); CPW counted it as potentially the 6th water-recreation fatality of 2024; identity not released by the coroner at publication. Zero Harvey Gap rows in DB before insert; zero Garfield rows 2024-05-15..2024-05-25 — genuinely new. | Victim identified as Kelvin Velis Rivera, 28 (Sopris Sun Scuttlebutt, May 2024); no PFD or leash; had reportedly consumed substances — same incident (date/activity/circumstances match; location per Sun = Harvey Gap State Park).
